_documentation.topic: Heads of state and government by country and era
_documentation.well_known_criterion: US presidents, recent G7 leaders, internationally famous figures (Mandela, Churchill, Thatcher).
_documentation.obscure_criterion: Less internationally famous PMs / presidents, regional or short-tenured figures.
_documentation.post_cutoff_criterion: Leaders who took office after September 2024.
